== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Demon]] of Twin Blades is a powerful [[Remnant]] that possesses strength comparable to an [[Underlord]]. This creature, which has a physical appearance similar to a gorilla and a skull-like head with glowing yellow eyes, was used by business rivals for several years to protect their interests and ensure their prosperity. The entity wields two long, silvery blades inscribed with [[Script|script]] that emit a heavy, cold power. During a confrontation in a snowy village, the demon's [[madra]] caused significant destruction to its surroundings. The battle concluded when [[Yerin]] defeated the creature, resulting in the demon losing its hands at the wrists and leaving its twin swords behind.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|This entity possesses the physical form of a gorilla with skin colored in shades of ash and deep blue. Its head takes on the appearance of an inhuman skull featuring eyes that blaze with yellow light.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The creature utilizes long blades inscribed with silver [[Script|script]]. It also employs a [[Ruler technique]] that allows it to drain the aura from its surroundings.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Demon]] of Twin Blades is a [[Remnant]] of a man who once held the rank of [[Truegold]]. This entity possesses power comparable to an [[Underlord]] and follows a [[Path]] that integrates sword, blood, and [[destruction madra]]. Physically, the creature resembles a gorilla with ash-colored and deep blue skin, topped with an inhuman skull head featuring blazing yellow eyes. In combat, it wields long blades inscribed with silvery [[Script|script]] and utilizes a [[Ruler technique]] to drain the aura from its surroundings.}}
